descriptionChirho: Tyre (Hebrew tsur/tsor), the renowned Phoenician coastal city-state on the Mediterranean, a major commercial and maritime power in the ancient Near East. Referenced extensively in prophetic oracles of judgment (Isa 23; Ezek 26-28), historical narratives of alliance with Israel (Josh 19:29; 2 Sam 5:11; 1 Kgs 5:1; 9:11), and poetic texts (Ps 45:12; 83:7; 87:4). All prepositional forms (bare, min-, le-, we-, ke-) denote this same city across all occurrences.
